"""Fixed paired-frame supplementation control. No synthetic text, relabeling, or product edits."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,copy,random,math
from collections import Counter
from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
import numpy as np,cv2,yaml
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;PARENT=ROOT.parent;V2=PARENT/'coverage-v2'
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write=lambda n,o:(ROOT/n).write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def digest(image):
    value=14695981039346656037
    for byte in image.tobytes():value=((value^byte)*1099511628211)&0xffffffffffffffff
    return f'{value:016x}'

old=read(V2/'coverage-manifest.json');rows=copy.deepcopy(old['rows'])
groups=read(DATA/'out/coordinate-stationary-study-20261015/stationary-groups.json')['groups']
paired_train=[g for g in groups if g['first'] in [744,884]]
paired_dev=next(g for g in groups if g['first']==776)
# New experimental split only; old v2 files remain immutable. Keep all ten 744-753 frames in train.
# Remove 761-770 from monitoring to preserve a >10-frame gap after the complete group.
for r in rows:
    r['priorV2Split']=r['split']
    if r['historical']:continue
    n=int(r['id'][-6:])
    if 744<=n<=753:r['split']='train'
    if 761<=n<=770:r['split']='purged'
index={r['id']:r for r in rows}
train=[r for r in rows if r['split']=='train' and not r['historical']]
dev=[r for r in rows if r['split']=='development']
assert (len(train),len(dev),sum(r['split']=='purged' for r in rows))==(734,170,107)
for g in groups:
    assert len({index[m['id']]['split'] for m in g['members']})==1
for a in train:
    assert all(abs(int(a['id'][-6:])-int(b['id'][-6:]))>10 for b in dev)
assert all(index[m['id']]['split']=='development' for m in paired_dev['members'])
assert not any(r['id'].endswith('-001100') for r in rows)

# Crop coordinate training patches from real native full-line preprocessing outputs.
# Coordinates are label-informed geometry, never used for fixed-ROI end-to-end scoring.
inputs=read(ROOT/'supplement-inputs.json')['inputs'];input_index={i['sourceId']:i for i in inputs}
raw=read(ROOT/'supplement-preprocessing.json')
native_index={r['id']:r for r in raw['pipelines']['ppocr-contrast']}
(ROOT/'patches').mkdir(exist_ok=True);patches=[]
for g in paired_train:
    for m in g['members']:
        r=index[m['id']];item=input_index[m['id']]
        assert sha(Path(item['image']))==item['cropSHA256'] and item['sourceSHA256']==r['sourceSHA256']
        assert native_index[item['id']]['pixelDigest']==item['pixelDigest']
        # Original capture strip starts at x=0; the fixed native input starts at x=32.
        source_width=item['rect'][2];source_left=item['rect'][0]
        for variant in ['raw','contrast','tophat']:
            path=ROOT/'native-preprocessed'/f"{item['id']}.{variant}.png"
            pixels=cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(path.read_bytes(),np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
            trace=native_index[item['id']]['preprocessingTrace'][variant]
            assert digest(pixels)==trace['pixelDigest'] and list(pixels.shape[:2])==[48,trace['width']]
            scale=(pixels.shape[1]-8)/source_width
            left=4+math.floor((r['sourceRect'][0]-source_left)*scale)
            right=4+math.ceil((r['sourceRect'][2]-source_left)*scale)
            assert 4<=left<right<pixels.shape[1]-4
            crop=pixels[:,left:right].copy();target=ROOT/'patches'/f"{m['id']}.{variant}.png"
            assert cv2.imwrite(str(target),crop)
            patches.append({'id':m['id'],'group':g['id'],'variant':variant,'image':str(target),
                'text':r['text'],'expected':r['expected'],'cropSHA256':sha(target),
                'nativeImage':str(path),'nativeImageSHA256':sha(path),'nativePixelDigest':trace['pixelDigest'],
                'nativeRect':[left,0,right,48],'geometry':'label-informed training patch cropped after real native full-line preprocessing; not an evaluation ROI'})
assert len(patches)==81
patch_index={(p['id'],p['variant']):p for p in patches}
def balanced(items,size):
    pool=list(items);random.Random(20261015).shuffle(pool)
    return [pool[i%len(pool)] for i in range(size)]
base=[r for g in old['groups'] for r in balanced([r for r in train if r['sceneGroup']==g['group']],320)]
base+=balanced([r for r in rows if r['historical']],128)
assert len(base)==1728
pairs=[]
for n in range(128):
    g=paired_train[n%2];anchors=g['clearerAnchors'];hard=[m['frame'] for m in g['members'] if m['frame'] not in anchors]
    turn=n//2;clear=anchors[turn%len(anchors)];obscured=hard[turn%len(hard)]
    prefix=g['members'][0]['id'][:-6]
    variant=['contrast','tophat'][(n//2)%2]
    pairs.append({'group':g['id'],'clearer':prefix+f'{clear:06d}','obscured':prefix+f'{obscured:06d}',
        'routeVariant':variant,'note':'Same existing XYZ; ordinary supervised examples, no new contrastive loss.'})
trials={}
for name in ['pair-raw','pair-routes']:
    entries=[{**r,'variant':'base-raw'} for r in base]
    for p in pairs:
        for role in ['clearer','obscured']:
            variant='raw' if name=='pair-raw' else p['routeVariant']
            patch=patch_index[(p[role],variant)];entries.append({**patch,'pairRole':role})
    assert len(entries)==1984
    (ROOT/(name+'.txt')).write_text(''.join(e['image'].replace('\\','/')+'\t'+e['text']+'\n' for e in entries),encoding='utf-8')
    trials[name]={'entries':1984,'baseEntries':1728,'pairedSupplementEntries':256,'positiveXEntries':128,
        'uniqueSourceFrames':len({e['id'] for e in entries}),'orderedSamples':[{k:e.get(k) for k in ['id','variant','image','text','pairRole']} for e in entries]}
(ROOT/'development.txt').write_text(''.join(r['image'].replace('\\','/')+'\t'+r['text']+'\n' for r in dev),encoding='utf-8')
config_base=yaml.safe_load((V2/'coverage-positive.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
for name in trials:
    c=copy.deepcopy(config_base)
    c['Global'].update(save_model_dir=str(ROOT/name).replace('\\','/'),save_res_path=str(ROOT/(name+'-predicts.txt')).replace('\\','/'),eval_batch_step=[0,124])
    c['Train']['dataset'].update(data_dir=str(ROOT).replace('\\','/'),label_file_list=[str(ROOT/(name+'.txt')).replace('\\','/')])
    c['Eval']['dataset'].update(data_dir=str(ROOT).replace('\\','/'),label_file_list=[str(ROOT/'development.txt').replace('\\','/')])
    (ROOT/(name+'.yaml')).write_text(yaml.safe_dump(c,sort_keys=False),encoding='utf-8')
    export=copy.deepcopy(c)
    export['Global'].update(pretrained_model=str(ROOT/name/'latest').replace('\\','/'),save_inference_dir=str(ROOT/(name+'-infer-paddle30')).replace('\\','/'),d2s_train_image_shape=[3,48,320])
    for t in export['Eval']['dataset']['transforms']:
        if 'RecResizeImg' in t:t['RecResizeImg']['image_shape']=[3,48,320]
    (ROOT/(name+'-export-paddle30.yaml')).write_text(yaml.safe_dump(export,sort_keys=False),encoding='utf-8')
corpus=read(V2/'development-corpus.json')
write('development-corpus.json',{**corpus,'note':'170 fixed same-session development frames; stationary group 776-787 entirely excluded from new training; old v2 artifacts unchanged.',
    'frames':[f for f in corpus['frames'] if f['state']!='present' or index[f['id']]['split']=='development']})
manifest={'purpose':'Two matched-budget trials: paired raw native patches vs paired actual contrast/tophat patches. Same ordinary supervised loss and source-frame sequence.',
    'humanVerified':False,'independentAcceptance':False,'productionChanged':False,'previousSplitsRewritten':False,
    'splitCounts':dict(Counter(r['split'] for r in rows if not r['historical'])),
    'trainPairedGroups':[g['id'] for g in paired_train],'developmentPairedGroup':paired_dev['id'],
    'rows':rows,'patches':patches,'pairs':pairs,'trials':trials,
    'sources':{'v2ManifestSHA256':sha(V2/'coverage-manifest.json'),
        'stationaryGroupsSHA256':sha(DATA/'out/coordinate-stationary-study-20261015/stationary-groups.json'),
        'nativePreprocessingReportSHA256':sha(ROOT/'supplement-preprocessing.json')},
    'limitations':['27 paired training frames are existing data, not new independent locations.',
        '12 held-out paired frames are previously explored; v1 used them, new trials do not.',
        'No positive-X grass/snow full labels added; old XY-only grass and unknown snow are not training.',
        'Actual native preprocessing is preserved; label-informed coordinate patch geometry is training-only.',
        'No contrastive loss, temporal runtime memory, threshold tuning or production replacement.']}
write('paired-manifest.json',manifest)
# Manual geometry QA: actual BGR colors as displayed by PIL; each page has 14 sources × 3 variants.
for page in range(2):
    members=[m for g in paired_train for m in g['members']][page*14:(page+1)*14]
    sheet=Image.new('RGB',(1500,len(members)*83),'#222');d=ImageDraw.Draw(sheet)
    for n,m in enumerate(members):
        for col,variant in enumerate(['raw','contrast','tophat']):
            p=patch_index[(m['id'],variant)];im=Image.open(p['image']).convert('RGB');im.thumbnail((495,54))
            sheet.paste(im,(col*500,n*83+23));d.text((col*500+4,n*83+3),f"{m['frame']} {variant} {p['text']}",fill='white')
    sheet.save(ROOT/f'patch-qa-{page+1}.png')
print('Split:',manifest['splitCounts'],'historical positive:',6,'entries per trial:',1984,'native patches:',len(patches))

replay_pairs.py.text:
"""Native replay of new fixed-ROI dev cohort plus separately marked trained stationary groups."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,sys,json,hashlib,subprocess,importlib.util
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;PARENT=ROOT.parent;V2=PARENT/'coverage-v2'
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
write=lambda n,o:(ROOT/n).write_text(json.dumps(o,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
corpus=read(ROOT/'development-corpus.json');frames={f['id']:f for f in corpus['frames']}
assert len(frames)==319
manifest=read(ROOT/'paired-manifest.json');paired_ids={p['id'] for p in manifest['patches']}
full=read(DATA/'out/coordinate-label-expansion-20261015/expanded-corpus-v5.json')
training_frames=[f for f in full['frames'] if f['id'] in paired_ids]
assert len(training_frames)==27 and not paired_ids&set(frames)
write('training-pair-corpus.json',{**full,'note':'27 trained stationary frames: fit diagnostic only, never part of development accuracy.','frames':training_frames})
all_frames={**frames,**{f['id']:f for f in training_frames}}
original=read(DATA/'out/coordinate-line-study-20261015/english-aspect-full/inputs.json')['inputs']
inputs=[i for i in original if i['sourceId'] in all_frames and i['profile']=='readout-line']
assert len(inputs)==346
for i in inputs:
    assert not ({'expected','state'}&set(i))
    assert i['sourceSHA256']==all_frames[i['sourceId']]['captureSHA256']
    assert sha(Path(i['image']))==i['cropSHA256']
write('replay-inputs.json',{'formatVersion':1,'inputs':inputs})
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark',SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/benchmark.py')
b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
native=SOURCE/'out/build/coordinate-offline/IMaoCoordinateOffline.exe'
env=dict(os.environ);env['PATH']=str(DATA/'x64/Release')+os.pathsep+env.get('PATH','')
for name in sys.argv[1:]:
    model=ROOT/(name+'-infer-paddle30');output=ROOT/f'replay-{name}.json'
    assert not output.exists(),f'Preserve old evidence: {output}'
    before=b.provenance(SOURCE,DATA,ROOT/'development-corpus.json',native,DATA/'third_party/research/WutheringWaves-Navigator',model)
    result=subprocess.run([str(native),str(model),str(ROOT/'replay-inputs.json'),str(output),'1','aspect'],env=env,capture_output=True,text=True,errors='replace')
    (ROOT/f'replay-{name}.log').write_text(result.stdout+result.stderr,encoding='utf-8')
    assert result.returncode==0,result.returncode
    raw=read(output);b.verify_native_provenance(before,raw['metadata'])
    for route in raw['pipelines'].values():
        index={r['id']:r for r in route};assert len(index)==len(route)==346
        for i in inputs:assert index[i['id']]['pixelDigest']==i['pixelDigest']
    after=b.provenance(SOURCE,DATA,ROOT/'development-corpus.json',native,DATA/'third_party/research/WutheringWaves-Navigator',model)
    assert before==after;write(f'replay-{name}-provenance.json',before)
    print(name,'native replay completed: 319 development/negative/unknown +27 trained-fit diagnostic',flush=True)

"""Independent experiment invariants and coordinate recount; no production assertions changed."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,pickle,sys,re,importlib.util
from collections import Counter
import numpy as np,cv2,paddle,yaml
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;PARENT=ROOT.parent;V2=PARENT/'coverage-v2'
SOURCE=Path(r'C:\Users\Kahvia\.codex\worktrees\coordinate-offline-evaluation\WWMAP-TOOLS')
DATA=Path(r'C:\Dcode\WWMAP-TOOLS')
read=lambda p:json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def digest(pixels):
    value=14695981039346656037
    for byte in pixels.tobytes():value=((value^byte)*1099511628211)&0xffffffffffffffff
    return f'{value:016x}'
m=read(ROOT/'paired-manifest.json');rows={r['id']:r for r in m['rows']}
old=read(V2/'coverage-manifest.json');old_rows={r['id']:r for r in old['rows']}
assert m['sources']['v2ManifestSHA256']==sha(V2/'coverage-manifest.json')
assert m['sources']['stationaryGroupsSHA256']==sha(DATA/'out/coordinate-stationary-study-20261015/stationary-groups.json')
assert m['sources']['nativePreprocessingReportSHA256']==sha(ROOT/'supplement-preprocessing.json')
assert len(rows)==1017 and m['splitCounts']=={'train':734,'purged':107,'development':170}
dev={r['id'] for r in rows.values() if r['split']=='development'}
train={r['id'] for r in rows.values() if r['split']=='train'}
assert len(dev)==170 and len(train)==740 and not train&dev
assert not any(i.endswith('-001100') for i in train|dev)
for r in rows.values():
    assert r['text']==old_rows[r['id']]['text'] and r['expected']==old_rows[r['id']]['expected']
    assert sha(Path(r['image']))==r['cropSHA256'] and sha(Path(r['sourceImage']))==r['sourceSHA256']
    if r['split']=='train' and not r['historical']:
        assert all(abs(int(r['id'][-6:])-int(i[-6:]))>10 for i in dev)
for group in read(DATA/'out/coordinate-stationary-study-20261015/stationary-groups.json')['groups']:
    states={rows[r['id']]['split'] for r in group['members']};assert len(states)==1
    assert states==({'development'} if group['first']==776 else {'train'})
patch_index={(r['id'],r['variant']):r for r in m['patches']};assert len(patch_index)==81
for patch in m['patches']:
    assert patch['id'] in train and patch['id'] not in dev
    assert patch['text']==rows[patch['id']]['text']
    assert sha(Path(patch['image']))==patch['cropSHA256']
    assert sha(Path(patch['nativeImage']))==patch['nativeImageSHA256']
    pixels=cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(Path(patch['nativeImage']).read_bytes(),np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    assert digest(pixels)==patch['nativePixelDigest']
    left,top,right,bottom=patch['nativeRect']
    crop=cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(Path(patch['image']).read_bytes(),np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
    assert np.array_equal(crop,pixels[top:bottom,left:right])
for pair in m['pairs']:
    assert pair['clearer'] in train and pair['obscured'] in train
    assert rows[pair['clearer']]['expected']==rows[pair['obscured']]['expected']
assert len(m['pairs'])==128
raw_samples=m['trials']['pair-raw']['orderedSamples'];route_samples=m['trials']['pair-routes']['orderedSamples']
assert len(raw_samples)==len(route_samples)==1984
assert [r['id'] for r in raw_samples]==[r['id'] for r in route_samples]
assert raw_samples[:1728]==route_samples[:1728]
assert Counter(s['variant'] for s in raw_samples)=={'base-raw':1728,'raw':256}
assert Counter(s['variant'] for s in route_samples)=={'base-raw':1728,'contrast':128,'tophat':128}
assert {s['id'] for s in raw_samples}==train
for name in ['pair-raw','pair-routes']:
    samples=m['trials'][name]['orderedSamples'];lines=(ROOT/(name+'.txt')).read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    assert len(lines)==1984
    for s,line in zip(samples,lines):
        image,text=line.split('\t');assert Path(image)==Path(s['image']) and text==s['text']
        assert s['id'] not in dev
    assert sum(rows[s['id']]['expected']['x']>0 for s in samples)==128
paddle.set_device('cpu');initial=paddle.load(str(PARENT/'numeric-runtime-initial.pdparams'));training=[]
for name in ['pair-raw','pair-routes']:
    state=pickle.loads((ROOT/name/'latest.states').read_bytes());assert state['epoch']==5 and state['global_step']==615
    config=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/(name+'.yaml')).read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert config['Global']['epoch_num']==5 and config['Global']['seed']==20261015
    assert config['Global']['pretrained_model']==str(PARENT/'numeric-runtime-initial').replace('\\','/')
    assert config['Optimizer']['lr']['learning_rate']==1e-5
    weights=paddle.load(str(ROOT/name/'latest.pdparams'));assert set(weights)==set(initial) and len(weights)==968
    assert all(np.isfinite(v.numpy()).all() for v in weights.values())
    bn=[k for k in weights if k.endswith(('._mean','._variance'))];assert len(bn)==302
    assert all(np.array_equal(weights[k].numpy(),initial[k].numpy()) for k in bn)
    changed=sum(not np.array_equal(weights[k].numpy(),initial[k].numpy()) for k in weights if k not in bn);assert changed>0
    log=(ROOT/(name+'-train.log')).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig')
    assert not re.search(r'\bloss:\s*(?:nan|inf)\b',log,re.I)
    assert 'not matched with loaded params' not in log and 'not in model' not in log
    folder=ROOT/(name+'-infer-paddle30');meta=yaml.safe_load((folder/'inference.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
    assert meta['PostProcess']['character_dict']==(folder/'ppocr_keys.txt').read_text(encoding='utf-8').splitlines()
    assert len(meta['PostProcess']['character_dict'])==14 and read(folder/'inference.json')['base_code']['version']==1
    assert [t['RecResizeImg']['image_shape'] for t in meta['PreProcess']['transform_ops'] if 'RecResizeImg' in t]==[[3,48,320]]
    training.append({'name':name,'epochs':5,'optimizerUpdates':615,'imagePresentations':9840,'uniqueTrainingSources':740,
        'finiteParameters':968,'unchangedBNBuffers':302,'changedOtherEntries':changed,
        'weightsSHA256':sha(ROOT/name/'latest.pdparams'),'logSHA256':sha(ROOT/(name+'-train.log')),
        'inferenceFiles':{n:sha(folder/n) for n in ['inference.json','inference.pdiparams','inference.yml','ppocr_keys.txt']}})

spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('benchmark',SOURCE/'tools/coordinate-ocr/benchmark.py')
b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
development=read(ROOT/'development-corpus.json');fit=read(ROOT/'training-pair-corpus.json')
all_frames={f['id']:f for f in development['frames']+fit['frames']}
assert Counter(f['state'] for f in development['frames'])=={'present':170,'absent':141,'unknown':8}
assert {f['id'] for f in development['frames'] if f['state']=='present'}==dev
inputs=read(ROOT/'replay-inputs.json')['inputs'];input_index={i['id']:i for i in inputs};assert len(input_index)==346
for i in inputs:
    assert not ({'expected','state'}&set(i)) and sha(Path(i['image']))==i['cropSHA256']
    assert i['sourceSHA256']==all_frames[i['sourceId']]['captureSHA256']
report=read(ROOT/'paired-report.json');summary={(s['model'],s['mode'],s['group']):s for s in report['summary']}
evidence={r['model']:r for r in report['sourceEvidence']};verified=0
for model in ['initial','v2-positive','pair-raw','pair-routes','yolo']:
    source=evidence[model];path=Path(source['path']);assert sha(path)==source['sha256'];payload=read(path)
    if model=='yolo':
        old_inputs=read(path.parent/'inputs.json')['inputs'];index={i['id']:i for i in old_inputs if i['profile']=='upstream-band' and i['sourceId'] in all_frames}
        pipelines={'yolo':[p for p in payload['results'] if p['id'] in index]}
    else:
        index=input_index;pipelines={mode:[p for p in values if p['id'] in index] for mode,values in payload['pipelines'].items()}
        if model.startswith('pair-'):
            prov=read(ROOT/f'replay-{model}-provenance.json');b.verify_native_provenance(prov,payload['metadata'])
    for mode,predictions in pipelines.items():
        assert len({p['id'] for p in predictions})==len(predictions)
        for p in predictions:assert p['pixelDigest']==index[p['id']]['pixelDigest']
        cohorts=[('all-development',{f['id'] for f in development['frames']}),
                 ('trained-pairs-fit-only',{f['id'] for f in fit['frames']}),
                 ('heldout-stationary-776-787',{i for i in dev if 776<=int(i[-6:])<=787})]
        cohorts += [(g['group'],{i for i in dev if rows[i]['sceneGroup']==g['group']}) for g in old['groups']]
        for group,ids in cohorts:
            if (model,mode,group) not in summary:continue
            pp=[p for p in predictions if p['id'].split('@')[0] in ids]
            ii=[i for i in index.values() if i['sourceId'] in ids]
            cc={'frames':[f for i,f in all_frames.items() if i in ids]}
            _,scored=b.summarize(cc,ii,{mode:pp});s=summary[(model,mode,group)]
            assert s['correct']==sum(r['exactXYZ'] is True for r in scored)
            assert s['wrong']==sum(r['wrongXYZReturn'] is True for r in scored)
            assert s['miss']==sum(r['abstained'] and r['state']=='present' for r in scored)
            assert s['falsePositive']==sum(r['falsePositive'] is True for r in scored)
        verified+=len(predictions)
for path,d in read(DATA/'out/coordinate-label-expansion-20261015/verification.json')['sourceHashes'].items():assert sha(Path(path))==d
for row in read(PARENT/'source-tree.json')['files']:
    data=(PARENT/'PaddleOCR-source'/row['path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha1(f'blob {len(data)}\0'.encode()+data).hexdigest()==row['sha']
historical=[]
historical_corpus=read(V2/'historical-evaluation-corpus.json')
for name in ['pair-raw','pair-routes']:
    folder=ROOT/('historical-'+name);r=read(folder/'report.json');native=read(folder/'ppocr.json')
    assert r['repeats']==3 and r['sourceFrameIds']==11
    assert not {f['id'] for f in historical_corpus['frames']}&{i for i in train if rows[i]['historical']}
    b.verify_native_provenance(r['provenance'],native['metadata'])
    ss,samples=b.summarize(historical_corpus,read(folder/'inputs.json')['inputs'],native['pipelines'])
    original={(s['profile'],s['mode']):s for s in r['summary']}
    for s in ss:
        for key in ['xyCorrect','xyzCorrect','wrongXYReturns','wrongXYZReturns','falsePositives']:
            assert s[key]==original[(s['profile'],s['mode'])][key]
    historical.append({'model':name,'reportSHA256':sha(folder/'report.json'),

"""Training-patch fit diagnostic, explicitly NOT end-to-end accuracy or validation."""
from pathlib import Path
import os,sys,json,copy,hashlib
os.environ['NO_ALBUMENTATIONS_UPDATE']='1'
ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;PARENT=ROOT.parent
sys.path.insert(0,str(PARENT/'PaddleOCR-source'))
import paddle,numpy as np,cv2,yaml
from ppocr.modeling.architectures import build_model
from ppocr.postprocess import build_post_process
from ppocr.data.imaug.rec_img_aug import RecResizeImg
paddle.set_device('cpu')
manifest=json.loads((ROOT/'paired-manifest.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
config=yaml.safe_load((ROOT/'pair-routes.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
decoder=build_post_process(config['PostProcess'],config['Global']);n=len(decoder.character)
arch=copy.deepcopy(config['Architecture']);arch['Head']['out_channels_list']={'CTCLabelDecode':n,'SARLabelDecode':n+2,'NRTRLabelDecode':n+3}
resize=RecResizeImg([3,48,384]);patches=manifest['patches']
images=[resize({'image':cv2.imdecode(np.frombuffer(Path(p['image']).read_bytes(),np.uint8),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)})['image'] for p in patches]
reports=[]
for name,path in [('initial',PARENT/'numeric-runtime-initial.pdparams'),('pair-raw',ROOT/'pair-raw/latest.pdparams'),('pair-routes',ROOT/'pair-routes/latest.pdparams')]:
    model=build_model(arch);weights=paddle.load(str(path));model.set_state_dict(weights);model.eval();outputs=[]
    with paddle.no_grad():
        for start in range(0,len(images),16):
            pred=model(paddle.to_tensor(np.stack(images[start:start+16]))).numpy()
            decoded=decoder(pred)
            for p,(text,score) in zip(patches[start:start+16],decoded):
                outputs.append({'id':p['id'],'variant':p['variant'],'expected':p['text'],'text':text,'score':float(score),'exactText':text==p['text']})
    summary=[{'variant':v,'frames':27,'exact':sum(o['exactText'] for o in outputs if o['variant']==v)} for v in ['raw','contrast','tophat']]
    reports.append({'model':name,'paddleVersion':paddle.__version__,'weightsSHA256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'summary':summary,'predictions':outputs})
    print(name,summary,flush=True)
result={'scope':'81 label-informed training-patch inputs across 27 training sources, Paddle CPU3.0 direct component. Not held-out, not end-to-end accuracy.','reports':reports}
(ROOT/'component-fit-diagnostic.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
